a.aria-label: EVE-261: Integrate the modular platform and prove every owner-required acceptance gate. CURRENT / BLOCKED. Captured Linear: In Progress. 2026-11-17: blocker: Bootstrap timeout cause remains unproven. Historical CI output does not distinguish late module/startup work from post-log shutdown delay. Bounded fd3 phase capture is implemented for the next actual occurrence with unchanged 10000 ms child limits, signals, results and existing assertions; executable equivalence, invalid-journal/redaction and synthetic timeout controls exercise diagnostics only. No force-exit, retry, deadline increase, telemetry repair or whole-issue acceptance is established. Source checkpoint predates delivery; exact-head CI is separate evidence, not a refreshed issue snapshot. Sources: https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-261#comment-c0e0d66f-9f2c-4009-9164-3695a7413038, https://github.com/Resnovas/Eventiva/actions/runs/44096066749/job/134083384961, https://ampcode.com/threads/T-1cb8af52-2e52-4924-bb42-cc7c523a6ddc. 13 prerequisites; 0 unlocks.
